name: Financial Assistance and Grants to Sports Associations/ Clubs/ Sports Committees of Uttarakhand
benefit: Recognized associations, clubs, and sports committees will receive financial assistance as follows: - National-level competitions: ₹3.50 lakh - State-level competitions: ₹2.50 lakh - District-level competitions: ₹1.00 lakh Additionally, there is a provision to provide ₹2.50 lakh to players selected to represent at the international level.
_eligibility_text: 1. The recognized Sports Associations, Clubs, and Sports Committees in Uttarakhand are eligible to receive financial assistance or grants under this scheme.
